title: Interlanguage Mathematical Translation Methodology: Slavic, Interslavic, Constructed-Language, and Terminology-Governance Notes
version: 2026-07-02 DOI candidate / source-handoff state, laptop branch through 6b983a15
description:
This candidate record preserves the linguistic-methodology layer that grew out of the multilingual mathematics translation work: Ukrainian, Russian, Interslavic, constructed-language, terminology-governance, reviewer-authority, and cross-language mathematical-translation notes.

Scope. The record is intended for logbooks, terminology scaffolds, language-planning notes, reviewer-role packets, source-evidence shelves, Slavic-triangulation material, interlanguage reflections, and machine/human workflow observations. It should be cross-linked from the Emmy Noether record and the workflow/replication packet, but maintained separately because its value is partly linguistic and methodological rather than only author-specific.

Current handoff state. The current GitHub-side evidence includes the imported 2026-06-29 Slavic/interlanguage tree, the 2026-07-02 local interlanguage notes handoff, and the laptop Noether language-planning handoff mirrored through branch commit 6b983a15. The laptop handoff adds promotion-readiness, review-intake, visual-inspection, Simplified Chinese first-page triage, French missing-unit, and Arabic/Persianate source-register ledgers. These are methodology and source-evidence artifacts, not completed language editions.

Status. This is not a Noether reader release, not native-speaker approval, not term approval, not mathematical source certification, not language synchronization proof, and not a critical edition. It is a maintained research/provenance lane for interlanguage mathematical translation practice.

GitHub mirror. Corrections, issue reports, and pull requests can be made through the public GitHub mirror.
